label: Small Biotech IND — CMC Drug Substance (3.2.S)
description: Module 3.2.S Drug Substance for novatide alfa (bispecific antibody, CHO-expressed).

inputs.appearance: White to off-white lyophilized cake or powder
inputs.solubility: Freely soluble in water for injection; >100 mg/mL at pH 6.0
inputs.synthetic_steps: CHO-K1 cell culture → Protein A capture → Ion exchange chromatography → Viral inactivation → UF/DF → Bulk DS filtration
inputs.process_description: Fed-batch CHO culture (14 days), harvested by depth filtration + 0.2 µm, purified by 3-column chromatography, viral inactivation by low pH hold, polished by AEX, UF/DF to formulation buffer (10 mM histidine, 150 mM NaCl, 0.02% PS80, pH 6.0)
inputs.structure_elucidation: Confirmed by intact mass (LC-MS), peptide mapping (LC-MS/MS), SEC-MALS, and X-ray crystallography of Fab fragments
inputs.appearance_spec: White to off-white cake or powder
inputs.analytical_procedures: All methods validated per ICH Q2(R2). Compendial methods per USP/Ph.Eur. as applicable.
inputs.validation_summary: Method validation reports available for identity (CEX, peptide map), purity (SE-HPLC, CE-SDS), potency (reporter gene bioassay), and impurity methods.
inputs.reference_standards: Primary reference standard (NVT-RS-001) established from batch NVT-DS-001. Qualified by full characterization suite. Secondary working standard (NVT-WS-001) calibrated against primary.
inputs.container_closure: 50 mL Type I borosilicate glass vials with 20 mm FluroTec® coated butyl rubber stoppers and aluminum flip-off seals
inputs.lt_result: All parameters within specification; aggregates trending stable at 0.7–0.9%
inputs.lt_conclusion: Supports 18-month retest period (extrapolated per ICH Q5C)
inputs.im_result: Comparable to long-term; no trends observed
inputs.ac_result: Slight increase in aggregates at 3 months (1.2%); within spec at 6 months (1.6%)
inputs.retest_period: 18 months at -20 °C ± 5 °C (proposed; supported by 12-month real-time data + extrapolation)
